title: 第25章 山谷盆地第26章 忘忧村改
content_zh:
回到了圣墟城主府，沐云走出了微型传送阵后，便来到了城主府府库。
沐云拿出了一个成人巴掌大的荷包，这是＂帝望＂中，较为稀少的空间道具，只是这东西是一次性的，通常是原住民ＮＰＣ在发放大量奖励，或者大笔交易时才会用到，里面装着沐云此行的收获。
沐云将道具一件一件的取出，并将之放进府库，妥善分类着。等到沐云把最后一件道具取出后，荷包状的一次性空间道具便自动化为碎片，这时，天色已经渐渐的亮了起来。
看了看府库里的道具，一种成就感油然而生。沐云笑了笑，又从府库里取出了些许道具，其中一个道具叫做：建村令。
......
大汉帝国，益州，未命名的巨大山谷盆地
沐云举着火把，从裂缝洞口中走了出来。他从圣墟传送回了微型位面后，便一路往回走，经过裂缝洞穴，回到了位处益州的巨大盆地。这一次，沐云有备而来，不仅带着火把，还带着镐子和铲子，加上属性提升后的体能，沐云很轻易的便通过了＂隧道＂，不似一开始那样，不但累得半死还花了不少的时间。
＂还好我有准备。＂看着眼前的湖泊，沐云笑笑的从背包中取出了一个小船的模型。他对模型点选＂使用＂之后，便将模型放入湖水中，这个模型便迅速变大着，很快的一艘小船便停泊在了湖泊上。
＂帝望＂中，原住民ＮＰＣ有能力将建好的建筑，船只，等等大型的东西，浓缩成一个个小小的模型，这些模型只要放置好之后，点选＂使用＂，这些道具便会＂原地展开＂迅速的＂恢复原形＂，不需要在花时间和材料去建造，不过在展开之后，便无法再缩回模型状态。
只是这一类的道具极其稀有，通常是用于特殊建筑当中，而且同一种模型也有着数量的限制。只是这一类的技术，并无法让玩家学习使用，为原住民ＮＰＣ所独有。但是实际上，沐云知道这只是一种空间折叠的运用罢了，只是碍于＂帝望＂的规则，沐云并不能在＂帝望＂中复现出来，不过倒是能将技术带回现世就是了。
上了小船，沐云便轻轻的将之划动，在湖泊中慢慢前行，向着盆地的腹地而去。
巨大的盆地，若由上往下看去，呈现出一个不规则的三角形，北方窄而南方宽。在盆地的最北边，有一座由山泉溪流所汇聚的大型湖泊，湖泊的西南边延伸出了一条小河，这条河水沿着盆地边缘靠近山脉处，先是一路向着西南，到了盆地中段的位置，却转向东南，直到注入了盆地东南方的小型湖泊。
沐云为了方便，便将北方的大型湖泊简称为＂大湖＂，东南方的小型湖泊简称为＂小湖＂，命名完之后，还一幅怡然自得的样子：你看！简单好认又方便！
小湖东侧的底下，有着一条水下溶洞，一路向东而去，从底部穿越了屏障盆地的山脉，最终与山外的一个小型湖泊相通，而这也是巨大盆地唯一与外界联结的通道。
盆地的中心腹地，土壤肥沃，而且因有河水邻近，是个好种庄稼的地方。盆地的正东边，还有着一条不算小的矿脉存在。而盆地的西边和南边，则郁郁葱葱，大树林立。
＂帝望＂在演化的过程中，可不是照本宣科的将地形一并复制。各大帝国的版图疆域，均与其历史原型极为相似，但是由于＂帝望＂的疆域要比之更加庞大，因此在地形上便有了许多的不同之处，有的山变得更高更雄伟了，有的河变得更宽更长了，有的池塘变成了湖泊，有的树林变成了森林，不一而足。
＂帝望＂各个国家的版图虽大，但是实际上却有着许许多多的＂盲点＂，这些＂盲点＂有大有小，但是通常存在于所谓的＂荒郊野领＂之中。其中有些＂盲点＂看似不起眼，里边却另成一方天地，而这一类的地方在未来，又被玩家称之为＂秘地＂。
＂秘地＂存在的位置不是极为隐密，便是易守难攻，更甚者两者皆备，同时各项资源的产出都不差，可以说是最好的建村所在，是未来玩家的建村首选，一但被人发现便会引来腥风血雨。而沐云所在的巨大山谷盆地，便是所谓的＂秘地＂，而且还是最顶级的那一类。
而除了＂秘地＂之外，还存在着所谓的＂险地＂和＂绝地＂。
＂险地＂的存在，一般来说在资源产出方面，是比较贫乏的，可是却都极易防守，什么悬崖峭壁，沼泽流沙，毒蛇猛兽，都只是基本操作而已。因此，未来有许多玩家都会选择在这一类的＂险地＂建村，或许成长的速度会慢一点，但是被攻打的可能也会少一点。

至于＂绝地＂的存在则非常极端，必须在特定的时间从特定的路径才能进入，如若硬闯或误入，基本上是没有存活的可能。＂绝地＂的总面积通常都很大，可是里面的面积通常都不怎样，不过资源产出方面倒是极为丰厚，而少数＂绝地＂里面，甚至还有着某些恐怖的存在。因此，即使在未来，会选择到＂绝地＂建村的玩家，也是少之又少。
不过可惜的是，在＂帝望＂所有的＂盲点＂里面，以＂绝地＂的数量最多，＂险地＂的数量次之，＂秘地＂的数量最少。因此绝大部分的玩家，未来还是会在野外建村，或靠山，或靠水，或接近ＮＰＣ城池。
在沐云的努力之下，最终还是渡过了湖泊，踏上了盆地的腹地。
尽管沐云在使用＂全知＂时，便知道了这座山谷盆地的存在，甚至知道盆地的附近有着什么资源，可是那毕竟是粗略的扫视，有很多东西还是要亲眼观察之后，才能够准确的判断。
在仔细观察和计算之后，沐云才作出了决定。他将建村令从背包空间里取出，对着前方的某处选择了＂使用＂。
一座简陋的村庄，便出现在了沐云的眼前。
content_en:
Returning to the Holy Ruins City Lord's Mansion, Mu Yun walked out of the miniature teleportation array and then came to the City Lord's Mansion Treasury.
Mu Yun took out a purse the size of an adult's palm. This is a relatively rare space prop in "Emperor's Hope". However, this thing is one-time use. It is usually used by Aboriginal NPCs when issuing large amounts of rewards or making large transactions. It contains Mu Yun's gains from this trip.
Mu Yun took out the props one by one and put them into the treasury, sorting them properly. After Mu Yun took out the last prop, the purse-shaped disposable space prop was automatically broken into pieces. At this time, the sky was gradually getting brighter.
After looking at the props in the treasury, I felt a sense of accomplishment. Mu Yun smiled and took out some props from the treasury. One of the props was called: Village Building Order.
...
Han Empire, Yizhou, unnamed huge valley basin
Mu Yun held a torch and walked out of the crack. After he teleported back to the micro-plane from the Holy Ruins, he walked back all the way, passing through the fissure cave and returning to the huge basin in Yizhou. This time, Mu Yun came well prepared. Not only did he bring a torch, but he also brought a pickaxe and a shovel. With his improved physical fitness, Mu Yun easily passed through the "tunnel". Unlike at the beginning, he was not only half exhausted but also spent a lot of time.
"Fortunately, I was prepared." Looking at the lake in front of him, Mu Yun took out a model of a boat from his backpack with a smile. After he clicked "Use" on the model, he put the model into the lake. The model quickly grew in size, and soon a small boat was anchored on the lake.
In "Emperor's Hope", aboriginal NPCs have the ability to condense built buildings, ships, and other large things into small models. Once these models are placed and click "Use", these props will "expand in place" and "restore their original shape" quickly. There is no need to spend time and materials to build, but after expansion, they cannot be retracted to the model state.
It’s just that props of this type are extremely rare and are usually used in special buildings, and there are also limits on the number of the same model. It's just that this type of technology cannot be learned and used by players, and it is unique to aboriginal NPCs. But in fact, Mu Yun knew that this was just an application of space folding. However, due to the rules of "Emperor's Hope", Mu Yun could not reappear in "Emperor's Hope", but he could bring the technology back to the real world.
After getting on the boat, Mu Yun gently rowed it and slowly moved forward in the lake, heading towards the hinterland of the basin.
The huge basin, if viewed from top to bottom, presents an irregular triangle, narrow in the north and wide in the south. At the northernmost edge of the basin, there is a large lake gathered by mountain springs and streams. A small river extends from the southwest of the lake. This river flows along the edge of the basin close to the mountains. It first goes all the way to the southwest, and when it reaches the middle of the basin, it turns southeast until it flows into the small lake in the southeast of the basin.
For the sake of convenience, Mu Yun shortened the large lakes in the north to "big lakes" and the small lakes in the southeast to "small lakes". After naming them, he looked contented: Look! Simple, easy to recognize and convenient!
Underneath the east side of the small lake, there is an underwater cave, which goes all the way east, passing through the mountains of the barrier basin from the bottom, and finally connects to a small lake outside the mountain, and this is also the only connection between the huge basin and the outside world.
The central hinterland of the basin has fertile soil and is a good place to grow crops because of the nearby river. Directly east of the basin, there is a rather small mineral vein. The west and south sides of the basin are lush and full of trees.
In the process of evolution of "Diwang", it does not copy the terrain according to the script. The territory of each major empire is very similar to its historical prototype, but due toThe territory of "Diwang" is larger than that, so there are many differences in the terrain. Some mountains have become taller and more majestic, some rivers have become wider and longer, some ponds have turned into lakes, and some woods have turned into forests, and so on.
Although the territories of the various countries of "Diwang" are large, they actually have many "blind spots". These "blind spots" may be large or small, but they usually exist in the so-called "wilderness areas". Some of these "blind spots" may seem inconspicuous, but they are a whole other world inside. This type of place will be called "secret places" by players in the future.
The location of the "Secret Land" is either extremely secretive, easy to defend and difficult to attack, or even better, it has both. At the same time, the output of various resources is not bad. It can be said that it is the best place to build a village, and it is the first choice for future players to build a village. Once it is discovered, it will cause a bloody storm. The huge valley basin where Mu Yun is located is the so-called "secret place", and it is also the top category.
In addition to "secret places", there are also so-called "dangerous places" and "desperate places".
The existence of "dangerous areas" is generally poor in terms of resource output, but they are extremely easy to defend. Cliffs, swamps, quicksands, poisonous snakes and beasts are all just basic operations. Therefore, many players will choose to build villages in this type of "dangerous areas" in the future. The growth rate may be slower, but they may also be less attacked.
As for the existence of "Jedi", it is very extreme. It can only be entered through a specific path at a specific time. If you break in by force or by mistake, there is basically no possibility of survival. The total area of ​​"Jedi" is usually very large, but the area inside is usually not that big. However, the resource output is extremely rich, and a few "Jedi" even have some terrifying existences inside. Therefore, even in the future, there will be very few players who will choose to build villages in "Jedi".
But it is a pity that among all the "blind spots" in "Emperor's Hope", the number of "jedi places" is the largest, followed by the number of "dangerous places", and the number of "secret places" is the least. Therefore, the vast majority of players will still build villages in the wild in the future, either on mountains, near water, or close to NPC cities.
With Mu Yun's efforts, he finally crossed the lake and stepped into the hinterland of the basin.
Although Mu Yun knew the existence of this valley basin when he used "omniscient", and even knew what resources were near the basin, it was only a rough glance after all, and there were many things that needed to be observed with his own eyes before he could make an accurate judgment.
After careful observation and calculation, Mu Yun made a decision. He took out the village founding order from the backpack space and selected "use" to somewhere in front of him.
A simple village appeared in front of Mu Yun.
